candidates.queue_depth_overload: ceiling events at >slot-count concurrency, or failure rate rising steeply with in-flight count
candidates.slot_specific_periodic_stalls: ceiling events at LOW-to-normal concurrency while other agents' decides complete in ~2 s during the same interval
candidates.uniform_steady_overload: constant-rate stall regardless of concurrency, uniform in wall-clock time

stall_verdict.verdict: slot-specific per-request stalls, uniform in time and load-insensitive (NOT queue-depth overload; NOT discrete periodic waves). ~13% of decides hit an independent ~90 s hang (the client's own 90 s timeout firing) while the server keeps serving other requests in ~2 s at 23/32-slot occupancy.
stall_verdict.fix_lever_follows: server-side :8091 (llama.cpp slot/KV-cache defect or restart cadence), NOT more slots; client-side, a shorter decide timeout (e.g. 15 s) cheaply caps each stall because the immediate retry succeeds in ~2 s (see retry_chain gap_failed_decide_to_next_request_s).
